description: The reader names three sources to put side by side: a scene they are reading, their own earlier note, and the essay the application supplied. The bundle must hold all three and leave out an unrelated note, without ranking anything.

input.cue: Put the Caterpillar asking Alice who she is next to that essay you have for me and what I wrote about not recognising myself after the move.

tool_evidence.excerpt: After the move I kept catching myself not recognising the person in my new routine, as if I had changed several times in one month.
Reminder to myself: plant the tomatoes after the last frost and water the herbs on Sundays.
The Caterpillar asks who Alice is. Alice says she hardly knows because she has changed several times and cannot explain herself.

tool_evidence.title: Personal Identity and Ethics
tool_evidence.excerpt: The source asks what our continuity over time implies for responsibility toward our earlier and later selves.

book_judgement.strength_reason: The retrieved passages answer the scenes the reader named.
